checks.explanation: As of mid-2026 Russia has not won the war. It controls roughly 18-20% of Ukraine's territory (Crimea plus parts of Donetsk, Luhansk, Zaporizhzhia, and Kherson), with only slow, incremental gains after more than four years of fighting and roughly a million Russian casualties, not the swift subjugation of the whole country the prediction argued against.

sources.title: The Russia-Ukraine War Report Card, July 2026
